name: gmail_watch
description: Runs automatically every 2 hours to check Gmail, summarize what's new, and only speak up if something looks important.
instructions: Use the mcp_gmail tools to check for unread/new email. Summarize it in a couple of sentences. Judge whether anything is genuinely important or time-sensitive (a real person needing a reply, a deadline, a security/account alert) versus routine newsletters/promos/notifications. Always call remember_fact (category="fact") with a one-line record of this check, e.g. "Gmail check <time>: N unread, nothing important" or "...: important - <what>", so there's a saved log either way. If something important was found, give a short spoken summary of it as your final reply. If nothing important was found, give NO spoken reply at all - respond with empty text, since this is a silent background check and routine results shouldn't interrupt the user.
